title: Double Haloumi & Beetroot Relish Burger
subtitle: with Garlicky Fries
description: Bright beetroot lends it's signature flavour to a quick relish that is the perfect topping for these veggie burgers.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak. Set aside.
• Cut potato into fries and place on the lined oven tray. Sprinkle with garlic seasoning, season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.
• Toss to coat and bake until tender, 20-25 mins.

• Meanwhile, grate beetroot.
• Thinly slice brown onion (see ingredients).
• In a large frying pan, heat a good drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook beetroot, onion, the balsamic vinegar and brown sugar until softened, 2-3 mins.
• Add the water and cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced, 5-6 mins. Transfer to a bowl. Season to taste.

• Drain haloumi and pat dry then slice horizontally to get 1 piece per person.
• Wash and dry frying pan and return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook haloumi with a splash of water, until golden, 2 mins each side (cook in batches if necessary).
• Meanwhile, halve continental rolls and bake directly on a wire oven rack until heated through, 2-3 mins.

• In a small bowl, combine the BBQ sauce and smokey aioli.
• Spread roll bases with BBQ aioli. Top with salad leaves, haloumi and beetroot relish.
• Serve with fries.
